title: Speciallæge på Billeddiagnostisk Afd., Aalborg Universitetshospital i Hobro
description:
Vagtfri fuldtids eller deltids stilling som Speciallæge på Billeddiagnostisk Afd., Aalborg Universitetshospital i Hobro

Sjældent opslået stilling ledig til vores afsnit i Hobro til besættelse snarest muligt.

Vi søger pr. 1. oktober eller efter aftale en speciallæge i radiologi, der gerne skal have en bred almenradiologisk erfaring – eller som har lyst til at skifte fra et sub-speciale til den bredere del af faget.

Afsnittet er kendetegnet ved et fantastisk godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden. Ydermere er stillingen kendetegnet ved at være vagtfri, og dette sammenholdt med de muligheder vi giver om at imødekomme eventuelle ønsker om deltidsansættelse gør, at dette er en særdeles attraktiv stilling, for dig der vægter et godt arbejdsmiljø og det brede radiologiske arbejde højt. Skulle du have lyst til en kombineret stilling mellem matriklerne i Aalborg og din primære arbejdsplads i Hobro, så kan det også være en mulighed.

Vores yngste uddannelseslæger kommer også til Hobro. Vi har erfaret, at det du og dine kolleger kan i Hobro, er helt unikt ift. at klæde vores kommende radiologiske kolleger på med grundlæggende radiologi. Derfor skal du have lyst til at sidde med nogle håbefulde og inspirerende mennesker, der kommer for at lære og suge viden ud af dig.

Om afdelingen og sektionen

Billeddiagnostisk Afdeling er en af landets største med et årligt undersøgelsesantal på ca. 285.000. Afdelingen diagnosticerer, undersøger og behandler patienter indlagt på Aalborg Universitetshospital samt henviste patienter fra de praktiserende læger i Region Nordjylland. Derudover udføres de højt specialiserede funktioner indenfor radiologi i Region Nordjylland kun i Aalborg. Afdelingen er fordelt på 5 matrikler: Hospitalsbyen, Aalborg Syd, Thisted, Hobro og Farsø. Den opslåede stilling er fysisk placeret i Hobro.

Du kommer i Hobro til at arbejde sammen med en erfaren gruppe af speciallæger, hvor hovedparten er ansat på deltid. Arbejdsopgaverne består af et bredt udsnit af ultralyd og CT. I ultralyd er der simple invasive procedurer i form af ascites- og pleuradræn. Desuden foretages konventionelle røntgenundersøgelser, hvoraf hovedparten beskrives af radiografer. Der er således ikke MR knyttet til funktionen, men har du erfaring og lyst hertil, er det også en mulighed. De tilstedeværende læger har forskellige kompetencer og supplerer hinanden.

Ansøgers kvalifikationer

Du skal være speciallæge i radiologi. Erfaring med ultralyd er en fordel.

Du have lyst til at arbejde et mindre sted, hvor din interesse og erfaring med bredden af radiologien vægter højere end sub-specialisering.

Det forventes, at du i forhold til afsnittet involverer dig i den daglige arbejdsgang og har visioner om dens fremtidige udvikling, herunder varetagelse af undervisning og supervision af yngre kolleger.

Personlige kvalifikationer

Der søges en læge med rigtig gode samarbejdsevner, fleksibilitet, loyalitet og empati. En læge som rummer en god personlig integritet såvel som evne til at udvise handlekraft og beslutsomhed, når det er nødvendigt.

Forskning og udvikling

Som universitetshospital har forskning og udvikling en høj prioritet. Universitetshospitalet indgår i væsentlig grad i både introduktions- og hoveduddannelsen i radiologi. Der arbejdes kontinuerligt på at udvikle et godt læringsmiljø, der sikrer de yngre læger en solid basis- og specialistuddannelse. Der vil derfor i stillingen indgå lægelig undervisning og supervision af yngre læger. Hvis du skulle have et ønske om at lave noget forskning eller publikationer, så har vi på matriklen i Aalborg et radiologisk forskningsafsnit. Og vores professor vil altid gerne hjælpe og give gode råd, hvis du skulle have noget du brænder for.

I stillingen lægger vi således overordnet vægt på:

  • Bred erfaring med det radiologiske område – eller som minimum lyst til det
  • Gerne uddannelsesmæssig erfaring
  • Gode samarbejdsevner
  • Visioner i forhold til sektionens samt afdelingens udvikling
  • At du tager ansvar for løsning af sektionens opgaver
  • Kan bidrage med lægelig undervisning

Yderligere oplysninger fås ved henvendelse til leder af Billeddiagnostisk Afdeling Peter Lasborg (peter.lasborg@rn.dk) tlf. 40207594

Ansøger vil blive bedømt ud fra de 7 lægeroller. Aalborg Universitetshospital har udarbejdet et skema til bedømmelse af lægefaglige kompetencer for ansøgere til speciallægestillinger i Region Nordjylland. Da en del af skemaet skal udfyldes af ansøger, bedes skemaet rekvireret på hjemmesiden:

Ved ansættelser i Region Nordjylland skal der indhentes reference samt børneattest på den ansøger, der ønskes ansat.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst for YL eller OVL indgået mellem Danske Regioner og Foreningen af Speciallæger.

Motiveret ansøgning vedlægges curriculum vitae. Ansøgning skal ske gennem regionens rekrutteringssystem

Ansøgningsfrist d. 20. september

Samtaler forventes gennemført torsdag d. 24. September 2026

Lønoplysninger
Som led i reglerne om løngennemsigtighed har du ret til at få oplysninger om den forventede startløn for jobbet.
På Region Nordjyllands hjemmeside finder du oplysninger om lønniveauer fordelt på stillinger og overenskomster samt Region Nordjyllands lønpolitik, der beskriver de objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier, som ligger til grund for lønfastsættelsen.
Hvis oplysningen om lønniveauet endnu ikke er tilgængeligt på hjemmesiden, vil du modtage det på anden vis inden en eventuel ansættelse.

Find oplysningerne på Regionen som arbejdsplads.

_Om Region Nordjylland
I Region Nordjylland søger vi hele tiden nye dygtige kolleger, der sammen med os vil arbejde for, at de nordjyske patienter og borgere er i gode hænder. Du bliver en del af et fællesskab med 15.000 kolleger på hospitalerne, det nære sundhedsvæsen, det præhospitale beredskab – og inden for de specialiserede sociale tilbud, regional udvikling og i administrationen. Vi er stolte af vores faglighed og samarbejde på tværs af hele organisationen.

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge jobbet – uanset etnisk baggrund, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, religion eller alder.

På Job i Region Nordjylland kan du læse mere om os og få et overblik over ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin._

As Director of Client Services and Community Engagement, you’ll have a dynamic and critical role supporting the daily administrative and front-end operations of VOAMASS Behavioral Health Services clinics, as well as building community partnerships and increasing referrals to the clinics. This position provides direct supervision, coordination, training, and support to Outpatient Medical Receptionists and oversees office workflow to ensure consistent reception coverage, client access, scheduling support, referral coordination, insurance verification, communication tracking, and general administrative follow-through. The Director of Client Services and Community Engagement is a unique opportunity to extend VOAMASS’ reach into the community by building relationships with primary care providers, community-based agencies, and other organizations to increase referrals and advance VOAMASS’ mission to help people access opportunity and achieve well-being.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide daily supervision, support, and direction to Outpatient Medical Receptionists to ensure front desk responsibilities are completed accurately, consistently, and timely.
  • Monitor and support daily front desk workflow, including client check-in, scheduling, rescheduling, client communication, co-payment collection, intake paperwork, referral tracking, EHR tasks, phone coverage, voicemail follow-up, fax/email routing, telehealth links, and appointment reminders.

  • Communicate front-end workflow concerns, staffing coverage issues, client access barriers, administrative trends, or higher-level client concerns to the Director of Outpatient Services as appropriate.

Manage referral list, scheduling clients, entering clients into the EHR, and coordinating provider availability. Support scheduling changes due to provider call-outs, availability changes, or provider transitions to ensure timely access and continuity of care.
  • Perform outreach to primary care providers, community-based agencies, and other service providers to inform them of available services and strengthen the referral pipeline .
  • Support clinical and medical providers with administrative follow-up related to appointment scheduling, client engagement, documentation routing, communication needs, and coordination of diagnostic, therapy, medication management, follow-up, and urgent appointments.
  • Assist with routine office management tasks, including ordering supplies, maintaining inventory, monitoring office equipment needs, reporting maintenance concerns, and helping ensure the clinic space remains welcoming, organized, safe, and professional.
  • Support administrative tracking, reports, audits, checklists, quality improvement activities, team meetings, supervision, workflow discussions, and other duties as assigned by leadership.

  • Experience in an outpatient medical, behavioral health, or healthcare office setting required.
  • Prior experience providing supervision, coordination, training, or lead support to administrative or front desk staff preferred.
  • The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of clinic operations, referral coordination, customer service, and administrative coordination.
  • Experience with MassHealth, commercial insurance, behavioral health services, and electronic health record systems preferred.
  • Must have excellent verbal, written, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Must be able to manage competing priorities, support staff in a fast-paced environment, communicate clearly with clients and staff, and follow through on administrative tasks.
  • Must demonstrate professionalism, sound judgment, trauma-informed communication, and the ability to support clients who may present with behavioral health, substance use, crisis, or complex social needs.

title: Clinical Coordinator
location: Illinois Sports Medicine & Orthopedic Surgery Center
description:
Founded in 1991, IBJI is the largest orthopedic group practice in Illinois. With more than 150 physicians in every orthopedic specialty, IBJI offers care for adults and children from some of the most accomplished and respected orthopedists in the country. Serving northern Illinois and northwest Indiana with over 100 locations, IBJI makes it easy to access care. Our headquarters is in Park Ridge, Illinois, a northwest suburb of Chicago. Our clinical services include advanced MRI imaging, pain management, non-surgical and surgical treatment plans, rheumatology, physical therapy, occupational therapy, wellness, and sports and sports training. Ortho Access walk-in clinics provide same day care for orthopedic injuries. Comprehensive care offered all in one place enables physicians, therapists and staff to work closely together, so that patients and families achieve better outcomes. Collaborative care is also more efficient. In many cases, IBJI services are substantially less expensive than those provided by large healthcare systems and emergency rooms.


Job Description:

The Clinical Coordinator is to provide coordination of therapeutic, effective patient/family-centered care according to physician orders, in compliance with the philosophy of the facility, standards of practice and regulations of governing agencies. Apply knowledge of the nursing process, illness, surgical procedures and anesthesia practice to the patient admissions process. The responsibility of this position includes communication with all staff members, management, physicians, anesthesia care providers, and the patient. Assess the patient and document the admission assessment process according to AORN Standards and Recommended Practice. Demonstrate the ability to evaluate, initiate and implement patient care based on this assessment process.


As a representative of this facility, all comments, attitudes, actions, and behaviors have a direct effect on the center's image and perceptions of quality service. Interaction with patients, physicians, referral sources, guest, visitors, volunteer workers, co-workers, supervisors, vendors, etc. must be in a manner that is friendly, supportive, courteous, respectful, cooperative, and professional. This behavior should promote an atmosphere of teamwork that is congruent with the center's standards and guidelines to promote positive relations.


Responsibilities

  • Serves as a preceptor and orients new members of the department, assisting when applicable, and assigning and directing work.
  • Responsible for maintaining clinical, communication and personal knowledge and skills required to meet the challenge of delivering safe and effective patient care.
  • Responsible for assisting with daily staffing, patient/physician/employee issues in conjunction with the Director of Nursing and Administrator.
  • Liaison between the center, the surgeon, anesthesia team and patient before admission to the surgery center.
  • Anticipates and assists anesthesia staff with gathering the necessary data for anesthesia metric qualifications approved by the Medical Executive Committee regarding Anesthesia Admission guidelines.
  • Demonstrates competency in all procedures within the scope of practice, as appropriate to the ages of the patient served, including the ability to obtain, interpret, and communicate information in terms of the patient’s needs.
  • Assess the health status of the patient by collecting data via: Patient interview, performance of a physical assessment for all age groups according to the plan of care, recognizing variances in the assessment which are normal/abnormal for the age group, review of records.

  • Participates in appropriate patient safety procedures.

title: SYSTEMS ENGINEER
description:
MAKE A DIFFERENCE AT OCHIN


OCHIN is a nonprofit leader in health care innovation and a trusted partner to a growing national provider network, delivering the clinical insights and tailored technologies needed to expand patient access, strengthen care teams, and improve the health of rural and medically underserved communities.


We are hiring for a number of new positions to meet increasing demand. When you choose to join OCHIN, you have the opportunity to continuously grow your skills and do meaningful work to help fulfill our vision of good health and well-being for everyone.


At OCHIN, we value the unique perspectives and experiences of every individual and work hard to maintain a culture rooted in our values.


Founded in Oregon in 2000, OCHIN employs a growing virtual workforce of more than 1,200 skilled professionals, working remotely across 49 states. We offer a generous compensation package and are committed to supporting our employees’ entire well-being by fostering a healthy work-life balance and opportunity for professional advancement. We are curious, collaborative learners who strive to live our values every day. OCHIN is excited to support our continued national expansion and the increasing demand for our innovative tools and services by welcoming new talent to our growing team.


Work Authorization

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis at the time of application.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. OCHIN does not provide sponsorship for employment-based visas or transfers of existing employment-based visas.


Position Overview:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting a wide range of system-related technologies, including hardware, operating systems, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and system performance. This role ensures the seamless operation and integration of these systems within the OCHIN and member technology environment. The Technical Advisor will monitor system performance, identify areas for improvement, and plan necessary upgrades to meet organizational needs. In addition to system maintenance, the Systems Engineer provides technical guidance and mentorship to team members, offering expertise and support on complex issues. They will collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure system configurations align with current requirements and proactively address any potential challenges to system availability and capacity.


Essential Functions:

  • System Administration and Infrastructure Management: Specify, operate, and maintain Windows and Linux operating systems (server and desktop platforms). Ensure production infrastructure meets service level commitments and system performance standards. Oversee Active Directory Enterprise Administration, Group Policy management, and automation through scripting (PowerShell, VBScript) to optimize system processes and configurations.
  • Subject Matter Expert (SME) Leadership and Technical Guidance: Act as OCHIN’s SME for key systems and platforms, including Windows engineering, Citrix infrastructure, Microsoft 365 administration, and Epic Hyperspace & Desktop. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to team members, ensuring best practices and solution alignment with organizational goals. Guide teams through complex technical challenges and system configurations.
  • Project and Solution Management: Lead or participate in complex customer and internal projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver effective system solutions. Research, analyze, and propose system and platform improvements that align with business and service needs. Develop technical specifications and roadmaps for evolving enterprise solutions, ensuring integration with other key systems, such as Epic and related operational databases.
  • Process Optimization and Automation: Proactively and reactively identify opportunities for process optimization and problem prevention across technologies and teams. Implement automation of routine tasks and optimize hardware/software platforms to improve system performance, reduce downtime, and ensure scalable operations. Document and standardize system procedures to enhance operational efficiency.
  • On-Call Support and Continuous Improvement: Participate in an on-call rotation, acting as the escalation point for technical issues and providing support for other Systems Engineers. Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by maintaining solid technical competence, mentoring team members, and driving alignment between technology, business, and IT operations. Support the creation and upkeep of documentation and contribute to OCHIN’s overall IT knowledge repository.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Deicer / Salt Operator
description:
Deicer / Salt Operator

Location: Central New York (CNY Area)

Job Type: Seasonal


About J and R Property Services

At J and R Property Services, our team is what sets us apart. We take pride in delivering exceptional service while maintaining a strong culture built on teamwork, professionalism, safety, and respect. Every team member plays an important role in our success, and we appreciate employees who are willing to step up when winter weather arrives.


As a Deicer / Salt Operator, you'll play a vital role in preventing hazardous winter conditions by applying deicing materials to commercial properties before, during, and after snow and ice events.


Key Responsibilities

  • Safely operate salt trucks, spreaders, and other deicing equipment to apply deicing materials to commercial parking lots, drive lanes, roadways, sidewalks, and other designated areas.
  • Monitor weather conditions and respond quickly to snow and ice events.
  • Respond to winter weather events within 30 minutes of being contacted.
  • Work overnight, early morning, weekend, holiday, and extended shifts during snow and ice events.
  • Safely load and unload deicing materials into trucks and equipment using tracked skid steer.
  • Ensure assigned properties are serviced thoroughly, safely, and according to company standards and customer contracts.
  • Perform pre-shift and post-shift inspections of vehicles, spreaders, and related equipment.
  • Maintain clean, fueled, and ready-to-operate equipment throughout the season.
  • Perform basic equipment maintenance and report mechanical issues or equipment malfunctions to your supervisor immediately.
  • Accurately document completed services using a tablet while on-site.
  • Maintain communication with supervisors regarding route progress, weather conditions, and operational needs.
  • Follow all company policies, procedures, DOT regulations (when applicable), and safety standards.
  • Assist with other snow removal or seasonal property maintenance duties as assigned.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, financial performance, and growth of the firm's engineering operations, including both Civil/Land Development and Water/Wastewater practice areas. This leader oversees engineering staff, project delivery, business development, client relationships, resource planning, budgeting, and operational excellence across multiple offices and disciplines.

The Director of Engineering serves as a member of the senior leadership team and is responsible for ensuring the firm's technical services are delivered safely, efficiently, profitably, and in alignment with the company's strategic goals. This position provides leadership to engineering managers, project managers, and technical staff while driving organizational growth and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Essential Responsibilities:


Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the engineering division's strategic plan in alignment with corporate objectives.
  • Establish annual growth, revenue, profitability, staffing, and operational goals.
  • Provide leadership and direction for Civil/Land Development and Water/Wastewater business units.
  • Identify new market opportunities, service offerings, and geographic expansion initiatives.
  • Participate in executive leadership planning and decision-making.

Operational Management

  • Direct the overall operations of engineering departments and project teams.
  • Ensure consistent project execution, quality control, and adherence to company standards.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), utilization rates, project profitability, backlog, and resource allocation.
  • Drive process improvements that increase efficiency and project delivery effectiveness.
  • Develop and implement best practices for project management and engineering operations.

Financial Management & Budgeting

  • Develop and manage annual departmental budgets.
  • Monitor revenues, expenses, profitability, and forecasting.
  • Review project financial performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
  • Support pricing strategy, contract reviews, and project risk management.
  • Ensure achievement of revenue, margin, and growth objectives.

Staff Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop engineering managers, project managers, and technical staff.
  • Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, retention, succession planning, and organizational development.
  • Conduct performance evaluations and establish individual development plans.
  • Foster a culture focused on accountability, safety, innovation, and professional growth.
  • Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.

Client Development & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with municipal, commercial, industrial, and development clients.
  • Serve as an executive-level point of contact for key accounts and strategic projects.
  • Lead major pursuits, presentations, proposals, and negotiations.
  • Support business development efforts and identify opportunities for revenue growth.
  • Increase client satisfaction through exceptional project execution and responsiveness.

Project Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of engineering projects and programs.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual requirements.
  • Monitor project risks, staffing demands, and workload allocation.
  • Review and resolve escalated project issues and client concerns.
  • Champion quality assurance and quality control initiatives.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Oversee engineering standards and professional practice requirements.
  • Mitigate operational, contractual, and project risks.
  • Promote workplace safety and regulatory compliance.
  • Support legal and contractual review processes as needed.

title: Land Development Project Manager
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of Texas development? At DCCM, our Land Development Team plays a vital role in transforming raw land into thriving communities and successful commercial spaces. We specialize in the planning, design, and management of residential, commercial, and municipal development projects—guiding them from concept through construction. From master-planned communities and mixed-use developments to single-site projects, our engineers and project managers deliver innovative, cost-effective, and sustainable solutions that enhance infrastructure, support growth, and improve quality of life across Texas.


We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Project Manager to join our collaborative and dynamic team in Houston, TX. You will play a key role at DCCM by overseeing and managing residential land development projects, including site grading, drainage, roadway construction, utility infrastructure, and residential community planning. In this role, you will provide guidance and leadership throughout the planning, design, and construction phases. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and advance your career while contributing to the creation of vibrant, sustainable residential communities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, schedule, assign, supervise, and motivate the work of project team members
  • Effectively design and manage all aspects of land development projects from concept, to design, through completion
  • Perform and oversee the design of land projects including but not limited to layout, grading, drainage, infrastructure, erosion and sediment control, etc.
  • Ensure performance of QA/QC procedures on all project deliverables
  • Coordinate inspection of construction work performed under contracts, including the interpretation and revision of plans and specifications while maintaining related records and reports
  • Provide direction to staff engaged in the design, preparation of drawings, plans specifications, and estimates for a variety of projects and contracts
  • Perform and manage multiple projects and tasks within specific budgets, schedules, and deadlines
  • Monitor projects to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations and coordinate activities with various project approval agencies
  • Professionally represent client issues at meetings and conferences with project stakeholders
  • Read and interpret technical engineering reports and studies, analyze facts, make independent decisions, and communicate all findings to client and project stakeholders, as appropriate
  • Act as an internal consultant to fellow team members, providing input for business decisions and effectively communicating said decisions
  • Recommend and refine improvements to departmental procedures on an on-going basis, identifying “best business practices”
  • Support pre-contract and business development efforts as required, serving as technical consultant
  • Prepare clear, concise correspondence and complex technical reports using correct punctuation, spelling and grammar
  • Performs other duties as requested

description:

Focused on promoting mental well-being, you will work within a multidisciplinary team to address the diverse needs of students and contribute to creating a safe and supportive school environment.


Responsibilities:


Trauma-Informed Counseling:


Provide individual and group counseling to students, utilizing trauma-informed approaches to address a range of behavioral and emotional concerns.


Conduct comprehensive assessments to identify trauma-related symptoms, triggers, and coping mechanisms.


Collaborate with students to develop personalized treatment plans that incorporate evidence-based interventions and promote resilience.


Mental Health Promotion:


Develop and implement psychoeducational workshops and activities aimed at promoting mental health awareness, stress management, and self-care among students.


Collaborate with school staff to integrate trauma-informed practices and social-emotional learning initiatives into the school curriculum and culture.


Advocate for a supportive and inclusive school environment that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.


Collaboration and Consultation:


Collaborate with parents/guardians, teachers, and other school personnel to coordinate services and support systems for students with complex needs.


Provide consultation and training to school staff on trauma-informed approaches, crisis intervention, and de-escalation techniques.


Serve as a resource and liaison between the school and community mental health agencies to facilitate access to additional support services as needed.


Documentation and Evaluation:


Maintain accurate and confidential client records, including progress notes, treatment plans, and outcome measures, in accordance with professional standards and legal requirements.


Participate in ongoing evaluation and quality improvement efforts to assess the effectiveness of counseling interventions and program outcomes.


Contribute to data collection and reporting efforts to measure the impact of the behavioral health and wellness program on student well-being and school climate.

description:
Valor Healthcare is looking for a passionate Laboratory Technician to join our team at the Community Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) in Washington county. In exchange for your dedication and experience, we are proud to offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits, three weeks of PTO to start and a weekday schedule.


About Valor Healthcare

Valor Healthcare is a veteran- and physician-led provider of healthcare services for deserving, resilient patriots – including those who serve or have served in the military as well as those who devote their careers to government service. We aim to deliver high-quality care in a way that upholds the health of our nation’s greatest asset: its people. Valor works hard to earn the trust of those who have faith in us to care for them with respect and through methods that lead to superior clinical outcomes.


Valor is different because of our people.

· Our leadership team is comprised of veterans, clinicians, and business leaders dedicated to providing exceptional care and a world-class patient experience.

· Many of our colleagues have patriots in their families or are patriots themselves, building a company culture and commitment to customer service that is second to none.


Position Overview


As a Medical Laboratory Technician (ASCP Certified), you will provide prescribed medical treatment and personal care services to patients with diseases and injuries seeking treatment in the clinic, as directed by physician or mid-level provider. ?You will collaborate with the core PACT Team (Primary Care Provider, RN and Medical Assistant) and expanded PACT Team including family/caregiver, VA, and community-based services involved in developing the patient care plan.?


Core Responsibilities

  • Perform in-house laboratory procedures on appropriate specimens to provide information for the diagnosis and treatment of diseases within the scope of the clinic.
  • Recognize and respond to critical values as they pertain to patient tests, results, controls, and proficiency samples
  • Ensure specimens are properly collected and labeled
  • Enter laboratory requests/results into the VISTA/CPRS system.
  • Ensure that all lab equipment is maintained and calibrated following manufacturers’ recommendations and clinic policies and procedures
  • Assure quality controls are run and documented per manufacture and system guidelines.
  • Comply with the performance measures and clinical guidelines as set forth in the current VHA Performance Measures Technical Manual or by verbal direction and comply with all requirements specified by the VAMC that issues the contract.
  • Comply with the CDC’s “Universal Precautions” for the prevention and transmission of HIV and other communicable diseases.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Compliance: Fulfill compliance requirements of the Office of Inspector General (OIG),
  • Joint Commission (JC), Environment of Care (EOC) oversight, lab compliance and other related items.
  • Responsible for ensuring that contaminated material and trash are maintained in proper containers (red bags)
  • Clinical Outcomes: Remain focused on achieving excellent clinical outcomes through the specified VA guidelines.
  • Customer Service: Must provide excellent customer service to each veteran, both in person and over the phone, as well as to fellow colleagues and clinic visitors.
  • Establish and maintain a warm, welcoming, and professional atmosphere for our colleagues and veterans, ensuring needs and expectations are consistently met.
  • Collaborates with Clinic leadership to resolve veteran concerns or complaints.
  • Ensure all clinical areas are cleaned, stocked and comfortable.
  • Monitor coffee service to insure availability to patients and guest.

description:

Location: Original Home Run Inn, Chicago, IL

That's where you come in.

You'll work with our recipes and standard operating procedures while helping keep the kitchen clean, organized, safe, and ready for service.

Making great pizza

  • Prepare and stock ingredients and dry goods needed for pizza and food preparation
  • Read order tickets and select the appropriate ingredients
  • Stretch and prepare pizza crusts using proper dough-handling techniques
  • Measure and apply ingredients according to HRI recipes and portioning standards

  • Remove pizzas from the oven and slice them for service

  • Work from both verbal and written orders

Preparing food for service

  • Assist other cooks with food preparation as needed
  • Prepare food quickly and efficiently to meet HRI prep-time goals
  • Read order tickets to determine the appropriate amount and type of food and supplies needed
  • Fill individual serving cartons with appropriate portions of food and condiments
  • Operate fryers, ovens, and other kitchen equipment safely
  • Monitor food quality and spoilage
  • Ensure food preparation areas remain clean and organized

Keeping the kitchen stocked and organized

  • Refill and rotate food stock as necessary
  • Rotate perishable food items using the FIFO method
  • Assist with inventory counts and ordering
  • Clean pizza ovens, meat tables, and food preparation equipment regularly
  • Keep your work area clean, organized, and safe
  • Follow all food safety, sanitation, and workplace safety requirements

Supporting the team

  • Communicate effectively with teammates and management
  • Assist other cooks and kitchen teammates during busy periods
  • Help maintain a smooth and efficient kitchen
  • Jump in where needed to support the restaurant team
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

You're a Great Fit If You...

  • Love food and take pride in making a great product
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Are a dependable team player
  • Pay attention to details and follow recipes and processes
  • Take pride in keeping your work area clean and organized
  • Are comfortable staying active and on your feet throughout your shift
  • Enjoy learning different areas of the kitchen
  • Are willing to work nights, weekends, and holidays

What You'll Bring

  • Must be at least 16 years old to operate kitchen equipment
  • Ability to constantly lift, reach, bend, and stoop
  • Ability to stand for extended periods, up to approximately 5 hours
  • Ability to safely lift and stack bags and cases weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance
  • Basic understanding of food safety and sanitation practices
  • Ability to safely operate kitchen and cooking equipment
  • Working knowledge of the predominant language of our guests
  • Flexible availability, including nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Typical evening availability may include 4 PM–close
  • Food Handler certification required within 30 days of hire
  • Safety shoes required within 30 days of hire
  • Previous restaurant, food preparation, or kitchen experience is a plus

Why Home Run Inn?

We're more than a pizza company—we're neighbors serving neighbors.


For four generations, we've built our business around people. We care deeply about our teammates because we know they're the reason families continue making Home Run Inn part of their traditions.


When you join our team, you'll find:

  • A family-owned company with nearly 100 years of Chicago history
  • Leaders who genuinely care about your growth
  • Opportunities to make a real impact on the teammate experience
  • A culture built around connection, support, and continuous improvement
  • Best & Brightest and Most Loved Workplace distinct recognition

  • Medical, Dental, Vision insurance options + supplementary insurances*
  • Take care of your growing family with Paid Parental Leave*
  • Build your future with our company 401k retirement savings plan, including company matching opportunities
  • Enjoy free household access to 24/7 on demand virtual healthcare
  • Save on everyday life with discounts on safety shoes, travel, entertainment and more
  • Access to all the pizza your heart desires! (Well, almost)

Our Values

Family – We show up for one another and succeed together.

Pride – We set high standards because our teammates and guests deserve our best.

Grit – We keep learning, improving, and finding better ways to do things.

Courage – We own our mistakes, speak honestly, and grow from every experience.

Purpose – To give people home runs in their day.


Ready to Join the Team?

If you're excited about making great pizza, preparing delicious food, being part of a hardworking team, and helping create memorable experiences for our guests, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help us give people more Home Runs in their day—one pizza at a time.

title: ASIC Design Engineer – DSP / Analog / SerDes
description:
ASIC Design Engineer – DSP / Analog / SerDes

Celero Communications is an exciting and fast-growing semiconductor startup developing innovative technologies that power next-generation AI and data center infrastructure. Our products enable high-performance optical connectivity and next-generation optical transceivers and modems.

Celero is seeking a highly skilled and motivated ASIC Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of advanced ASICs for high-speed optical communication systems. The ideal candidate will have strong digital ASIC design expertise combined with hands-on experience in DSP, Analog, and/or SerDes technologies.

What You Will Do
• Design and implement high-performance digital circuits and ASIC blocks using Verilog and SystemVerilog.
• Develop and integrate DSP, digital communication, and high-speed SerDes functionality into complex ASIC designs.
• Work closely with Analog, SerDes, DSP, Architecture, Verification, Physical Design, and Systems teams to develop and integrate mixed-signal ASICs.
• Participate in the design and development of high-speed data paths, signal processing blocks, control logic, and interfaces for optical communication systems.
• Perform synthesis, timing analysis, lint, formal equivalence, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), and related ASIC implementation and signoff activities.
• Optimize designs for performance, power, and area (PPA).
• Perform RTL simulation and debugging to ensure design functionality and performance.
• Contribute to block-level and top-level integration, verification, and silicon bring-up.
• Participate in architecture and design reviews and provide technical guidance to other engineers.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot complex design and system-level issues.
• Develop scripts and automation using Python, Tcl, or similar languages to improve design and verification efficiency.
• Contribute to ASIC development from architecture and RTL through tapeout and silicon validation.

What You Will Bring
• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in digital ASIC design, with demonstrated ownership of complex ASIC blocks or subsystems.
• Strong proficiency in Verilog and/or SystemVerilog.
• Strong understanding of digital design principles, RTL design, and ASIC development methodologies.
• Hands-on experience with ASIC design flows and industry-standard EDA tools.
• Strong knowledge of one or more of the following areas:
- Digital Signal Processing (DSP)
- High-speed SerDes
- Analog/Mixed-Signal ICs
- Digital communications
- Optical communications
• Experience working with DSP algorithms, data-path architectures, FEC, equalization, modulation/demodulation, or other high-speed communication technologies.
• Understanding of SerDes architectures and high-speed interfaces, including TX/RX datapaths, equalization, clocking, and related mixed-signal interfaces.
• Experience collaborating with Analog and Mixed-Signal design teams and understanding the interaction between digital, analog, and SerDes blocks.
• Experience with synthesis, static timing analysis, Lint, CDC, formal verification, and RTL simulation.
• Familiarity with verification methodologies such as UVM and/or formal verification.
• Knowledge of low-power design techniques and PPA optimization.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience designing ASICs for optical communications, optical transceivers, coherent communications, or high-speed networking.
• Experience with coherent DSP, FEC, modulation schemes, equalization, or high-speed data recovery.
• Experience with SerDes architectures, including TX/RX, CDR, PLLs, CTLE, DFE, ADC/DAC interfaces, or related high-speed mixed-signal circuitry.
• Experience working with advanced semiconductor process technologies.
• Experience taking ASICs from architecture/RTL through synthesis, physical implementation, tapeout, and silicon bring-up.
• Experience with MATLAB, Python, Tcl, or other modeling and automation tools.
• Understanding of optical communication standards and high-speed networking protocols.
• Experience working in a startup or fast-paced semiconductor development environment.

Why Join Celero?
At Celero, you will have the opportunity to work on challenging, high-performance semiconductor technologies at the intersection of AI infrastructure, optical communications, DSP, SerDes, and mixed-signal design. You will work closely with experienced engineers across multiple disciplines and have the opportunity to make significant contributions to products from architecture through silicon.

title: Observability & Tooling Engineer
description:
About Us

Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.

In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.

With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.

Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

Role overview:

Planet is investing in the evolution of its observability capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to help shape our future monitoring architecture, introduce modern observability practices, expand OpenTelemetry adoption, improve SLO governance, and build the tooling that enables proactive detection and faster recovery across a global payments platform.

As part of the Observability and Tooling team, you will own the observability lifecycle end-to-end, from architecture and design through implementation, automation, optimization, and ongoing evolution. You will

define monitoring standards, build scalable observability solutions, develop dashboards and alerting strategies, and continuously improve the platform through automation and engineering best practices.

What you will do:

  • Configure, tune and operate monitoring and observability across Planet’s broad, multi-vendor estate.
  • Own the alert lifecycle: test-mode onboarding, acceptance criteria, tuning and retirement of noise – make every page actionable.
  • Build dashboards and golden-signal views for the Command Centre floor and SLO reporting.
  • Manage monitoring, alerting and dashboards as code – version-controlled, peer-reviewed and repeatable.
  • Integrate tooling across the estate – observability, ITSM and CMDB (e.g. Jira / Jira Service Management, Device42) – so data flows and context is joined up.
  • Automate everything that gets done twice: scripting, integrations, self-healing and runbook automation.
  • Apply AI and AIOps where it adds value – correlation, noise reduction, anomaly detection and enrichment.
  • Instrument new and existing services to the golden-signal standard (latency, traffic, errors, saturation).
  • Help modernise and rationalise the toolset – reduce overlap, improve coverage and control cost.

Who you are:

Essential

  • 3+ years in observability / monitoring / tooling engineering or a tooling-heavy operations role.
  • Jira / Jira Service Management – our primary service management platform.
  • Hands-on with a modern log-analytics & observability platform – Coralogix (our primary monitoring & alerting platform) strongly preferred, or strong equivalent (Splunk, Datadog, Grafana).
  • Strong scripting & automation ability (Python, PowerShell or similar).
  • An eye for signal versus noise – you take pages personally.
  • English fluency required; based in Ireland or Poland.

Nice to have

  • Experience across the wider toolsets– Splunk, Grafana, Datadog, Site24x7, Pingdom, Idera, Netreo, SolarWinds, Device42.
  • Applying AI / AIOps to alerting and operations.
  • Monitoring & alerting as code (version-controlled config).

Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

description:
POSITION TITLE: Part-Time Housing Navigator (limited two years)

LOCATION/NEIGHBORHOOD: 65 Laguna Street, San Francisco, CA 94102

San Francisco neighborhood – Hayes Valley, Upper mid-market

ON-SITE: On-site 3x week

DEPARTMENT: Community Support Services Department

REPORTS TO: Manager of Housing and Resource Programs

FLSA STATUS: Part-time, Non-exempt

FTE STATUS: .50

COMPENSATION: $28.00-$31.00 per hour

PUBLIC TRANSIT PROXIMITY: ½ block from F Line, 1 block from Bus lines 6 & 7

SCHEDULE: 24hrs/week Tuesday-Thursday


**Bilingual candidates encouraged to apply**


POSITION SUMMARY:

Openhouse seeks a dynamic, compassionate person rooted in the spirit of community service who feels passionate about working with elders. Openhouse believes housing is healthcare and a human right. The Temporary Housing Navigator provides information and assistance for older adults and adults with disabilities with a focus on housing. In addition to being a neighborhood hub for services, the Openhouse is a city-wide resource for Lesbian, Gay, bisexual, Transgender, and Queer (LGBTQ) older adults and adults with disabilities. The Temporary Housing Navigator assesses the needs and capabilities of individuals, provides current information on opportunities and services available within the community, follows up as necessary, and documents the provision and outcomes of services to ensure program effectiveness and achievement of objectives. They work in collaboration with the Openhouse Community Support Services team. The Housing Navigator models Openhouse’s commitment to a trauma-informed, person-centered, affirming approach to providing services and building community.

This role is funded through a two-year grant. Employment is contingent upon the continuation of grant support, and the position is not expected to continue beyond the grant period.


ABOUT OPENHOUSE:

Openhouse was founded in 1998 to empower Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, and Queer (LGBTQ+) older adults to overcome the unique challenges they face as they age by providing LGBTQ+ welcoming housing, resources, high-impact direct services, and innovative community programs. As a result, Openhouse reduces isolation and empowers LGBTQ+ older adults to improve their overall health, well-being, and economic security. We are a dynamic and entrepreneurial on the leading edge of the growing field of aging services for LGBTQ+ older adults at the local, state, and national levels. Openhouse believes in manifesting opportunities with, and not just for, LGBTQ+ older adults to build and reconnect with community by providing housing, direct services, and community programs.


Openhouse is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including but not limited to candidates who identify as women, people of color, members of the LGBTQIA2S++ community, and individuals across the gender spectrum. We recognize that systemic inequities may discourage some candidates from applying unless they meet every qualification listed. If you believe your skills and experiences align with the role and you are passionate about our mission, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to our organization. Openhouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by law.

title: Culinary and Program Specialist (Full Time/Mon-Fri 9a-5p)
description:
This position is responsible for preparation and monitoring of the program’s food service plan, ensuring safe protocols are in place and effectively followed, and overseeing resident use of kitchen facilities. The Culinary and Program Specialist will offer group training pertaining to kitchen safety and related Adult Living Skills to individuals in recovery, as well as ensure the program remains an adequate inventory of food items and supplies. This position will offer support to the program to ensure smooth, consistent operation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Prepares healthy and nutritious meals in accordance with the agency’s four-week cycle menu and in accordance with the USDA/US Food Code/ NY Subpart 14-1.

• Maintains current Managers ServSafe certification. If not ServSafe certified, Culinary and Program Specialist shall obtain certification within 6 months of hire.

• Maintain all ordering and record keeping to remain in good status with FeedMore of WNY (to include Managers ServSafe Certification).

• Maintains an inventory of required program supplies that are necessary for the day-to-day operation of the program (bedding, hygiene care, cleaning supplies).

• Orders all food service supplies.

• Ensures compliance with OSHA standards, including using personal protective equipment, completing material safety data sheets, and more.

• Actively works with the agency’s Director of Kitchen Operations or Nutritionist to ensure that all residents’ dietary needs are being met.

• In addition to the supervisory relationship with the Program Manager, this position shall collaborate with the Director of Kitchen Operations.

• Conducts daily inspections of the kitchen to ensure compliance with all safety and sanitary standards. Maintains related sanitation and safety forms.

• Ensures that all safety-related systems, such as fire extinguishers and kitchen suppression systems, are working properly.

• Ensures that the program’s kitchen is operating efficiently and safely.

• Reports and documents any issues related to the kitchen or food service.

• Monitors the temperatures of all food service equipment including freezers, refrigerators, and coolers. Promptly informs program manager and supervisor of any concerns that arise

• Prepares, serves, and cleans up after the program’s meals.

• Monitors food temperature while preparing, cooking, and serving.

• Implements Caz Kitchen Basics and Safety to all residents and oversees their implementation afterwards.

• Ensures the food storage areas are clean, free of debris, and in compliance with standards set by the Department of Health.

• Maintains the program’s dining areas through set up and cleaning, and in compliance with standards set by the Department of Health.

• Maintains all stock of program supplies at all times (toilet paper, paper towels, and cleaning supplies)

• Helps maintain and teach residents how to use the Garden Tower.

• Reports any pest management issues to the Program Manager and Director of Kitchen Operations.

• Maintains a positive working relationship with the agency’s support services (US Foods, Food Bank of WNY, local vendors, etc.) in consultation with the Program Manager and Director of Kitchen Operations.

• Collaborate with the program manager/supervisor on duty to be present at all times when a 3rd party vendor is at your location.

• Assisting with assigning chores and follow up upon completion. Collaborate with the program manager with any additional deep cleaning that needs done.

• Assist with clean-up for room turnover

• Possess a general knowledge of contagious diseases (i.e., HIV, Hepatitis B, TB etc.) and takes precautionary measures to limit transmission.

• Maintains the SNAP program: obtains benefit cards, processes the daily collection and credits, and submission to administration on a weekly and monthly basis.

• Properly documents SNAP information into electronic documents (Edocs) by including benefit information, uploading of documents, and making financial notes when needed.

• Serves on agency committees as requested.

• Assists in the implementation of the agency’s policies and procedures.

• Is mindful of and integrates Trauma-Informed Care and its five principles in all duties and interactions with fellow staff, residents, and external partners.

• Maintains compliance with all required rules and regulations, including Federal Confidentiality (42 CFR, Part 2), HIPAA, Medicaid and/or HUD, and any others.

• Carries out duties essential to the above stated responsibilities as assigned.

• Regular attendance at work location.

• Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Other duties may be assigned.

title: BUSINESS ANALYST (CA)
description:
MAKE A DIFFERENCE AT OCHIN

OCHIN is a rapidly growing national nonprofit health IT organization with over two decades of experience transforming health care delivery to drive health equity. We are hiring for a number of positions to meet increasing demand. When you choose to join OCHIN, you have the opportunity to continuously grow your skills and do meaningful work to help fulfill our mission.

OCHIN provides leading-edge technology, data analytics, research, and support services to nearly 1,000 community health care sites, reaching nearly 6 million patients nationally. We believe that every individual, no matter their race, ethnicity, background, or zip code, should have fair opportunity to achieve their full health potential. Our work addresses differences in health that are systemic, avoidable, and unjust. We partner, learn, innovate, and advocate, in order to close the gap in health for individuals and communities negatively impacted by racism or other structural inequities.


At OCHIN, we value the unique perspectives and experiences of every individual and work hard to maintain a culture of belonging.

We offer a generous compensation package and are committed to supporting our employees’ entire well-being by fostering a healthy work-life balance and equitable opportunity for professional advancement. We are curious, collaborative learners who strive to live our values everyday: Learning, Heart, Belonging, and Impact. OCHIN is excited to support our continued national expansion and the increasing demand for our innovative tools and services by welcoming new talent to our growing team.


Position Overview:

The Business Analyst supports OCHIN’s mission by coordinating and delivering integrated products and services from preferred technology partners to member organizations. This role combines business analysis with project coordination, ensuring successful implementations, workflow optimization, and stakeholder alignment. The Analyst gathers and interprets business and technical requirements, manages timelines and deliverables, and provides subject matter expertise on supported products and systems. Acting as a bridge between technical teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders, the Analyst drives process improvements, resolves issues, and supports strategic initiatives that advance organizational goals. Please note: This position is funded through a contract. Continued employment is contingent upon contract renewal or extension, and organizational needs.

  • Lead and coordinate assigned projects from initiation to completion, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and quality standards are met. Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to maintain momentum.
  • Gather, document, and translate business and technical requirements into clear, actionable plans for implementation teams. Assess impacts of proposed changes and provide recommendations that support operational efficiency and member success.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, external vendors, and member organizations to align on project goals, expectations, and outcomes. Facilitate effective meetings, maintain transparent communication, and produce clear project documentation.
  • Evaluate workflows and operational processes to identify opportunities for improvement. Lead or contribute to initiatives that streamline operations, enhance system functionality, and improve service delivery.

title: Data Center Network Engineer - NVIS
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the potential of AI to define the next era of computing. As an NVIDIAN, you will work in a collaborative environment where people learn, contribute, and build technology that has a lasting impact.

NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialists (NVIS) supports the deployment and operation of AI Factory and enterprise data centers. We are seeking new college graduates who are eager to develop hands-on Ethernet networking skills while contributing to customer deployments. You will learn alongside experienced solutions architects and network engineers, working with modern compute, storage, and network platforms. This role is part of the NCG development program and represents multiple openings. You will build confidence in deploying and validating data center Ethernet networks, communicate progress and findings clearly, and contribute to reliable customer outcomes. With mentoring, practical experience, and feedback, you will grow toward an independent technical role within NVIS or the broader NVIDIA organization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Support the architecture design, implementation, and validation of Ethernet or InfiniBand networks for AI Factory and enterprise data center deployments.

  • Work with cross-functional teams to prepare sites, bring up network infrastructure, validate connectivity, and document results.

  • Assist with switch configuration, cabling validation, network troubleshooting, and issue resolution under the guidance of experienced engineers.

  • Learn and apply networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, and data center network architecture.

  • Contribute to repeatable deployment practices through documentation, automation, and knowledge sharing.

  • Participate in the NCG development program, which may include rotations across deployment, operations, validation, or related teams.

What we need to see:

  • BS.c, or MS.c, in Computer Science, Computer Architecture, Electrical Engineering, Math, Physics, Data Science, or related technical fields or equivalent experience

  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools

  • Foundational knowledge of Ethernet networking and the TCP/IP stack, gained through coursework, labs, projects, internships, or equivalent experience.

  • Evidence of structured troubleshooting and attention to detail, such as diagnosing a technical issue, documenting findings, and testing a solution.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work respectfully across teams and geographies.

  • Ability to work independently and with multi-disciplinary teams across multiple geographies

  • Able to prioritize work, adapt to changing deployment needs, and communicate progress clearly.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Hands-on experience with Ethernet switches, lab networks, VLANs, routing, or network simulation tools.

  • Exposure to data center infrastructure, server hardware, cabling, storage, or systems administration.

  • Coursework or projects involving Linux networking, Python, shell scripting, or network automation.

  • Familiarity with Cumulus Linux, VXLAN-EVPN, Ansible, or related automation and network-operations tools.

  • Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or equivalent learning achievements.

title: Projektchef
description:
Energrid

Energrid er et datterselskab under Thy-Mors Energi og arbejder med nettilslutning af mellem- og højspændingsanlæg. Hos os møder du kolleger med mange års erfaring, og fordi organisationen har en overskuelig størrelse, får du gode muligheder for at få dine idéer i spil og præge løsningerne. Her er der ikke langt fra tanke til handling, og man bliver lyttet til, hvis man ser en smartere måde at gøre tingene på. Du skal trives med at være en del af en organisation, hvor man hjælper hinanden, siger tingene som de er, og har et klart fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og professionel leverance.

Energrid er i vækst og med helt fremme, når det gælder nye teknologier som Power-to-X og batterianlæg. Her får du mulighed for at styrke dine kompetencer og spille en aktiv rolle i den grønne omstilling.

Få en central lederrolle i et stærkt vækstende selskab, der er med til at gøre en forskel i den grønne omstilling. Stå i spidsen for udviklingen af projektafdelingen med fokus på at løfte organisationen til næste niveau.

Med reference til direktøren i Energrid og som en del af ledergruppen bliver du en nøgleperson i virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling. Du vil træde ind i en vækstende virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på dels at eksekvere eksisterende projekter, som med årene er blevet større og mere komplekse, og dels at optimere og strømline projekteksekveringen og den overordnede projektstyring. Med andre ord får du et bredt job, der spænder fra strategiske og ledelsesmæssige opgaver til operationelle og mere forretningsorienterede opgaver.

Alsidigt job – ledelse, projektstyring og forretningsudvikling
Du får det overordnede ansvar for virksomhedens projekter og projektafdelingen bestående af et team på syv projektledere samt en projektassistent og en teamleder, der er ansvarlig for montageafdelingen. Samlet har du ansvaret for en organisation på i alt 25 medarbejdere.

I dagligdagen har du overblikket over projekterne og sikrer, at der leveres på de klassiske projektparametre omkring ressourcer, tid, økonomi og risiko. Du får en central rolle i at styrke afdelingens kommercielle projektmindset og sikre en sund arbejdskultur.

Som leder evner du at sætte en tydelig retning, motivere og udvikle en organisation, ligesom du skaber følgeskab gennem kompetent sparring, synlighed, tillid og løbende kommunikation med dine medarbejdere. Du får et fagligt stærkt team, der spænder over både erfarne og nyere projektledere, hvor en væsentlig opgave bliver at danne et fælles forum for vidensdeling samt sikre læring og opsamling af best practice på tværs af projektafdelingen.

Projektlederne arbejder selvstændigt, og du vil agere daglig sparringspartner, både når det hele kører godt, og når der opleves udfordrende projekter og tvister, ligesom du vil deltage i projektmøder og have forretningsdialoger med udvalgte kunder og samarbejdspartnere. Det er helt afgørende for succes i jobbet, at du favner ledelsesrollen og tager ejerskab for afdelingen, som gradvist skal videreudvikles, så projektafdelingen til enhver tid understøtter den dynamiske udvikling, virksomheden gennemgår.

I den kommende tid skal der bl.a. implementeres et projektstyringsværktøj, og ISO9001 skal implementeres fuldt ud i afdelingen, ligesom PMO-funktionen skal udvikles med rollen. I dag drives projekterne mere individuelt, og du skal evne kontinuerligt at standardisere og optimere arbejdsgangene og processerne i afdelingen. Her bliver det en nøgleopgave at sikre effektive overleveringer mellem salg og projektafdelingen samt at fortsætte det gode samarbejde på tværs af virksomheden, der også har en salgsafdeling, en serviceorganisation og en specialistafdeling.

Yderligere bliver du medlem af ledergruppen, som i dag består af en salgschef, en servicechef samt direktøren. Her forventes du at tage aktivt del i at videreudvikle den overordnede forretning, hvor dit kommercielle mindset og dine forretningsmæssige holdninger sættes i spil. Ledergruppen er relativt nysammensat, og der er et godt fundament for at opbygge et langsigtet ledelsesteam. Det er væsentligt for direktøren, at du bidrager med engagement, åbenhed og både med- og modspil i dialogerne.

Stærk projektlederværktøjskasse og erfaringer med at ”bygge nyt”
Der er flere indgange til stillingen. Enten sidder du i dag som projektchef, afdelingsleder eller entreprisechef i en mellemstor eller større virksomhed inden for el/energi/installation. Du kan måske også sidde i anlægs- og entreprenørbranchen eller være senior projektleder og klar til næste skridt i din erhvervskarriere. Alternativt sidder du i en større projekt-/produktionsvirksomhed med stærke kompetencer inden for ledelse og projektledelse.

Uanset ovenstående rolle har du din projektlederværktøjskasse på plads, herunder solid erfaring med de gængse projektlederdiscipliner, ligesom du har en teknisk uddannelse bag dig.

Vi forestiller os, at du kommer fra en organisation med et højt modenhedsniveau, hvor du har opnået en god forståelse for, hvordan en professionel projektorganisation bedst struktureres og udvikles. Du har erfaring med at skabe struktur, implementere fælles arbejdsmetoder og udvikle projektstyringen, samtidig med at du fokuserer på medarbejderne og den daglige drift.

Du har erfaring med at indgå i samarbejde med salg og generelt have en bred kontaktflade i dagligdagen. Det er væsentligt, at du har en kommerciel forståelse og har optjent din projekterfaring i en kommerciel drevet kontekst.

Det er et klart plus, hvis du har erfaring med ledelse, herunder personaleledelse, forandringsledelse og med at være en del af en ledergruppe. Det kan også være dit første lederjob, hvis du sidder som erfaren projektleder med de rette lederegenskaber.

Som person er du nærværende, ordentlig og tillidsvækkende. Du er en udpræget teamplayer, der har forståelse for, at Energrid er ét samlet hold. Du er ansvarsbevidst, resultatorienteret og har modet til at træffe beslutninger, håndtere vanskelige dialoger og skabe ro, når kompleksiteten stiger. Derudover møder du folk i øjenhøjde og er uformel i omgangstonen med andre.

Bliv en del af en virksomhed med et godt renommé, stærke værdier og store ambitioner
Hos Energrid bliver du en del af en virksomhed med stærke værdier og høje ambitioner. Kulturen er præget af høj faglighed, ordentlighed og et stærkt ønske om at levere løsninger, som både kunder og medarbejdere kan være stolte af. Her vægtes langsigtede relationer, samarbejde og kvalitet højere end kortsigtede gevinster.

Rollen har base på hovedkontoret i Thisted, hvor der som udgangspunkt forventes tilstedeværelse minimum fire dage om ugen. Samtidig tilbydes den fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar, som kendetegner virksomhedens kultur.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Research Consultant Sofie Vestergaard Daugaard på 4412 6721.

Bemærk, at vi kun har behov for dit CV, når du søger stillingen. Din henvendelse behandles fortroligt og videregives ikke uden din accept.

title: Cellular Therapies Processor
description:
LifeSouth Community Blood Centers is looking for an individual to make a difference in their community, while working in a laboratory setting, by joining our team as a Cellular Therapies Processor in Gainesville, FL. This position is responsible for tasks related to the safe handling, documentation and manufacturing of cord blood products and training. This position is also responsible for carrying out cord blood policies and procedures for filing, organizing and maintaining donor records and conducting routine communication activities with collection facilities, regional and laboratory staff as well as with cord blood registries.


This is a full-time position working four (4) 10-hour shifts per week, including one weekend day.


Our Benefits

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) plan
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurances available to full-time employees the first of the month after 60 days
  • Supplemental insurances including life, cancer, accident, and disability
  • Access to mental wellness resources and counseling through telehealth
  • Free basic life insurance for full-time employees
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match each pay period
  • Employer funded retirement plan for vested employees & 403b offered
  • Access to wages prior to pay day

Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to)

  • Comply with relevant federal and state laws and regulations regarding confidentiality and privacy of health information
  • Receive and perform daily morning assessing tasks of collected cord blood units (CBUs)
  • Process cord blood units, including isolating and preparing cord blood products in accordance with established laboratory procedures
  • Accurately maintain donor and CBU records, including compiling and reviewing CBU records for accuracy and completeness, updating all applicable logs, performing registration of cord blood donors, performing and recording any required QC or maintenance procedures and participating in quality-management activities
  • Perform submission of maternal sample tubes
  • Interface daily with regional collections staff to provide collection and processing statistics, collection facility training trends and abnormalities associated with collections
  • Maintain cord blood equipment including, but not limited to, liquid nitrogen storage tanks, cord blood processing equipment and temperature monitoring equipment
  • Maintain stock of supplies essential to job function
  • Work with Corporate Quality Assurance Coordinators to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations for equipment and testing procedures
  • Represent and communicate Cord Blood and LifeSouth favorably to the public and to the participating institutions

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; Associate or Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
  • Experience working in a blood bank or transplant center performing donor collection, accessioning, processing, storage and/or distribution functions preferred
  • Experience working in a cGMP-regulated laboratory environment preferred
  • Valid driver's license required; must meet and maintain LifeSouth driver's eligibility requirements
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal and team-building skills
  • Positive and outgoing attitude with excellent customer service skills
  • Ability to follow moderately complex oral and written instructions
  • Proficient in the variety of computer software applications
  • Knowledge of medical terminology preferred
  • Strong attention to detail preferred
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time and lift at least 50 pounds
  • Must be able to work a varied schedule including some weekends


Who We Are

LifeSouth is a non-profit community blood bank serving more than 150 hospitals in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and Tennessee. We are committed to meeting the blood supply needs of hospitals and their patients by providing the highest quality blood components and services. With more than 45 donor centers, 55 bloodmobiles and 2,000 blood drives a month, our LifeSouth team is dedicated to making sure the blood is there when you or your family is in need.


Our Mission

To provide a safe blood supply that meets or exceeds the needs in each community we serve, and to provide a variety of services in support of ongoing and emerging blood and transfusion related activities


This is a full-time position. Starting salary range is $20.00 - $22.00 an hour. Criminal background check and drug screen required upon conditional offer of hire. Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer/Drug-Free/Tobacco Free Workplace.


The position description may not include all the duties and responsibilities of the job. Duties and responsibilities that are not listed, but which the employee may be expected to perform, will fall within the scope of the skills, knowledge and training for the position.

LifeSouth is a Drug-Free and Tobacco-Free Workplace. LifeSouth is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor as well as an affirmative action employer and provides equal opportunity to all persons, regardless of race, religion, age, gender, disability, status as a protected veteran, national origin, color, or any other classification in accordance with federal, state, and local statutes, regulations, and ordinances. Veterans are encouraged to self-identify as LifeSouth desires to provide protected veterans priority referrals for open positions. LifeSouth complies with all laws and regulations associated with the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and the Americans with Disability Act (ADA). LifeSouth is an E-Verify employer.
